name: prompt-editor
description: Makes the prompt box work like a text editor, the same way for every prompt: Shift+Enter starts a new line (Enter sends), new lines keep their indentation, and prompts are sent exactly as typed. A helper-agent limit is applied as you send, shown in a one-line strip above the prompt. Stays on in every session; /prompt-editor off turns it off. /prompt-editor shows the settings; on|off, auto, none or <number> change them.
